issue.title: One-time token can be consumed twice concurrently
issue.body: Two attacker-controlled requests can execute consume_token concurrently. The database isolation level permits both transactions to read used=false before either writes. There is no conditional update, unique constraint, row lock, or other serialization. Audit whether the one-time-use invariant is enforced.

oracle.mechanism: A non-atomic read-check-act protocol violates a one-time-use invariant.
